name: LinkedIn
summary:
LinkedIn’s favicon is the small “in” mark on linkedin.com, used in tabs and bookmarks for the professional network. The table records the link tags the homepage exposed and the pixel size of each file that downloaded.

Checked 12 November 2026 against linkedin.com. HTML came from https://www.linkedin.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://static.licdn.com/aero-v1/sc/h/akt4ae504epesldzj74dzred8.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.linkedin.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 24838 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 24×24, 32×32, 64×64.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: svg-64x64-02.svg at 64×64 (svg, 833 bytes) from https://static.licdn.com/aero-v1/sc/h/akt4ae504epesldzj74dzred8.
